explanation: High side of a GELU-dip token-identity unit (the same neuron whose verified negative pole sits near the GELU minimum for most tokens): its activation is a fixed lookup on the current surface token - identical in every context and every syntactic role (' play' = 1.47 both as a verb and as a noun, ' make' = 1.46 after any prefix, 'making' = 1.48 across five unrelated registers), so the case form is a different token and matters (' door' 0.00 vs ' Door' 0.73, 'wish' 0.00 vs ' Wish' 0.94). It rises above zero only for a graded concrete everyday-action vocabulary: a top tier at 0.8-1.73 of the 1.729 max made of the generic activity verbs and their inflections (make/making/makes, do/does/doing, take/taking/took, play/playing/plays, watch, perform/performers, act, dance/dancers, hold/holding, render, wear) plus upper-case forms of several others (Cut, Hang, Pay, Pray, Wish); a mid tier at 0.4-0.8 of manual and leisure action verbs (draw, ride, skate, bake, roast, brew, chop, haul, cast, roll, conduct, practice, bend, cut, cook, hang); a scattering of animal/food nouns and capitalised names that no semantics predicts (' deer' 1.05 yet ' horse' 0.19, ' goose' 1.21 yet ' bird' 0.09, ' chess', Judith, Caesar); and one unexplained leftover, 'Even'/'even' (1.42/0.96). It is at zero on function words, on abstract/cognitive/communication verbs (think, know, want, say, tell, ask), on light and grammatical verbs (give, get, use, try, help, start, stop, find, put, look) and on concrete non-action nouns in their usual lower-case token (table, door, house, room, car, bread, soup).
